// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap self-found while diagnosing #2269's r1 void
// round (independently verified against real lizard 1.23.0 before
// fixing). stateDecToImp used to have no "[" branch at all, so legacy
// Java array-return syntax (valid since Java 1.0, still compiles today)
// fell through to the not-an-identifier fallback and abandoned the
// declaration back to global scope -- silently losing the function
// body's own condition count. Measured directly against real lizard
// 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + if).
class C {
    int f()[] {
        if (true) {
            return new int[0];
        }
        return null;
    }
}
